saw_lines: Laptop bags get bought once and judged daily, so buyers check the laptop fit and pockets before anything else.
So the laptop fit must sit in the first line, because a buyer who cannot see it scrolls on.
Your site shows 337 reviews, yet none of your 28 ads carries a proof number. Put 337 on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 337 reviews, yet none of your 28 ads carries a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust it. Put 337 on the creative and in line one, and open two ads with a review quote.
4 of 27 ads use claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results, which cuts reach. Swap each claim for what buyers notice first, like a 16 inch laptop sliding in with room to spare.

All 28 ads are video, so retargeting and the catalog have no still image to show people who already saw the bag. Add still images of Jolene and Ada for those placements, and run them beside your oldest video ad.
0 of 27 ads carry an offer, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Give them one reason, such as a first order offer or a Jolene and Ada bundle, and open three new ads with it.

ads_1: Review quotes and the 16 inch laptop fit as opening lines
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram
